slides.heading: Vaccine Heat Sensitivity
bullets: Most sensitive to heat (−15 to −25°C, freezer): OPV and MMR.
Least sensitive (+2 to +8°C, body of refrigerator): Pentavalent, Hepatitis B, BCG, TT.
